def factor_range_volume_herding_smooth(df):
    """Smoothed rolling correlation between log true range and log volume.

    Preserves the crowding/herding mechanism: when volume concentrates on
    high-volatility days, the correlation is positive. The raw 20-day
    correlation is smoothed over 5 days to reduce estimation noise and
    improve cross-sectional stability."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    true_range = np.maximum(df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"],
                            np.maximum((df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
                                       (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()))
    log_range = np.log(true_range.replace(0, np.nan).clip(lower=1e-12))
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy["volume"].clip(lower=1e-12))
    raw_corr = log_range.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(log_volume)
    factor = raw_corr.rolling(5, min_periods=3).mean()
    df_copy["factor_range_volume_herding_smooth"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_volume_herding_smooth"]
description: Preserves the core herding/crowding mechanism: positive rolling correlation between log true range and log volume indicates volume piling into high-volatility days. The parent's raw 20-day correlation is noisy, likely weakening ICIR/RankICIR. This mutation adds a 5-day moving average to smooth the correlation, preserving the bounded [-1,1] signal while reducing high-frequency estimation noise. One core mechanism, one lightweight smoothing modifier.
